article.title: Association of heavy metal with sperm parameters and sex hormones: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.
article.authors: Goodarzi S, Shafiee A, Rashidian P
article.journal: Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol X
article.abstract: Findings regarding the reproductive toxicity effect of heavy metals on sperm parameters and sex hormones level remain inconsistent. This study systematically reviewed and pooled the existing literature to assess the associations of heavy metal levels with sperm parameters and sex hormones.
